title: Science & research
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. One of the four NEW B2 strands in B2-PLAN, anchored to the knowledge/ideas family. Because it is new rather than a sequel there is no single predecessor to re-teach, but the sweep still did real work: research, experiment, theory, discovery, invention, method, species, evidence, data, scientist, trial and knowledge all came back already taught and are excluded. The CORRECTED sweep also caught two the repo's own pool could not see — bias and breakthrough, taught this morning by leaf_news_b2 and leaf_tech_b2, whose nodes are still `coming` (see the DECISIONS entry on pool blindness). Both dropped. So the unit is the method and the measuring rather than the nouns of school science: how research is done (hypothesis, laboratory, sample, variable, observe, analyse, replicate), how a result is judged (findings, conclusion, prove, disprove, significant, accurate, precise, correlation, statistics), and the material and the money (molecule, atom, gene, evolution, organism, peer review, funding, grant, patent). C49 all 36 words across three boards of 12. There is no C57 recap card because this strand has no predecessor unit — card 0 instead names the taught words it builds on. Build-the-family: analyse -> analysis, observe -> observation, conclude -> conclusion and prove -> disprove, all four derived forms drilled as bank items. A12 senses on sample (for testing) and grant (money), both of which have commoner everyday readings. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: What you already have
cards.note: This is a new strand, so there is no earlier unit to recap. What you already have is the big words — experiment, theory, evidence, data, discovery, invention, method, research, scientist. They come back in this unit's sentences. What is new is everything between them: how the work is actually done, how a result is judged good or not, and who pays for it.
cards.note_cz: Tohle je nová větev, takže není co opakovat. Už máš ta velká slova — experiment, theory, evidence, data, discovery, invention, method, research, scientist. Vracejí se ve větách. Nové je všechno mezi nimi: jak se práce doopravdy dělá, jak se pozná dobrý výsledek a kdo to platí.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Three verbs here build the nouns beside them, and one takes a prefix.
